_readme: Round 1 of reading rubric v2's flags (python -m evals.validate_rubric sample --per-item 10, seed 7), BEFORE the fixes it prompted. Kept so the paper can report precision before and after. true = the flag is right.

respects_target_status: labels3_fast:03:1 'Keep protein and calories as they are, focusing only on increasing steps' read as more protein
split_fast:08:2 'reduce the -40 kcal/day slope' (stop the decline) read as eating less
old_think:15:1 'Since protein is already sufficient, avoid increasing it' (negation after the cue)
labels3_fast:20:1 'boost calorie burn without adding more food or protein' (negated, and the boost is calorie burn)
old_think:07:2 'Maintain current protein intake without increasing further' (negation after the cue)
fix_matches_problem: old_think:06:0 'pair with earlier meals to avoid late-night overeating' ('overeating' not matched)
labels5_fast:H01:1 'keeping a small portion of your favorite snack only in the evening' / 'reduce the likelihood of overeating'
labels_fast:06:1 'Schedule a protein-rich snack' ('schedule' not an action verb)
labels6_fast:06:0 'Keep a small portion of your favorite snack and eat it only once a day'
large_calorie_gap_first: labels6_fast:H10:1 'Start each day with a small, protein-rich breakfast to keep calories in check'
no_keep_only_recommendation: labels_fast:15:2 'Keep the six workout sessions spread across the week, with the heaviest sessions in the early evening' (a scheduling change in an all-on-track week; borderline)
labels_fast:11:0 'Stick to the four daily workout sessions, ensuring each is completed in the early evening' (borderline)

decision: respects_target_status and the food-action vocabulary (used by fix_matches_problem, large_calorie_gap_first, first_recommendation_targets_a_problem, no_extra_movement_while_underfed) were fixed and re-validated on a fresh sample that excludes every flag read here. no_keep_only_recommendation was NOT changed (its two misses are borderline, and tuning it on the sample that measures it would bias its precision).
